uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Yoshimaru and Primal Vigor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-2033-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1417-2033-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2018-6288-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2018-6288-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-728-5470-6968.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-6968.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

729-2034-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Great Oak Guardian, adding at least one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

305-876-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Llanowar Tribe.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Llanowar Tribe.
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Llanowar Tribe.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Llanowar Tribe from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1722-5231-7687.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-5231-7687.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
When the Tentacle enters, Mister Fantastic triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {R}.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

341-618-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Umori.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1765-2440-6965-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-6965-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

339-677-4742-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4452-5256-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4452-5256-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

539-3899-4365-4552-5089.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-2557-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2930-3525-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Portent Tracker.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Tolvada // The Broken Sky

193-1238-2650.description:
If Aminatou has two or more loyalty counters on it, activate Heart of Kiran by removing a loyalty counter from Aminatou, causing Heart of Kiran to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until Aminatou has one loyalty counter on it.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting Invasion of Tolvada
Aminatou is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Aminatou ability, blinking Invasion of Tolvada.
When Invasion of Tolvada enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Aminatou from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-955-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with five or more charge counters on it

198-3368-4067-6571.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it.
198-3368-4067-6571.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast the spell, and causing you to draw a card if X was 4 or greater.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {R} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +6/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Reiterate, copying the instant or sorcery.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

659-5090-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Singing Bell Strike attached to Krenko.
659-5090-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Goblins.
659-5090-5231.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing six Goblin tokens, adding six {R}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

323-397-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
323-397-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.

2060-3129-3525-3574.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3129-3525-3574.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3129-3525-3574.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

2459-5147-5220-5683.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Rograkh from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Rograkh and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1987-4423-5733-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
1987-4423-5733-5913.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

2645-3717.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness, and has power 5 or greater.
2645-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3717.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1365-2034-3263-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2034-3263-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

3394-4050-4191-5010.notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
3394-4050-4191-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding one mana of any color.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

692-1335-4613-5231.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-1335-4613-5231.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Marath's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1494-1692-2646.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Sage of Hours.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1494-1692-2646.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Sage of Hours with haste that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Sage of Hours copy by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1308-1651-2561-4798.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, creating two Food tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil twice, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Repeat.

2965-4050-5110-5286.description:
Activate Helm of Kaldra by paying {1}, creating a legendary 4/4 Kaldra token and attaching Helm of Kaldra, Shield of Kaldra, and Sword of Kaldra to it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kaldra, adding {1}.
Repeat.

328-2034-2358-2693-3260.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
You have at least three opponents.
328-2034-2358-2693-3260.description:
Cast Gray Merchant of Asphodel by paying {3} and 4 life.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 7 life and gaining you 21 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant of Asphodel, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1} and 4 life, returning Gray Merchant of Asphodel from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying 6 life, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

331-3011-3333.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
331-3011-3333.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and damage to you that does not change your life total due to Platinum Emperion.
